raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A single request with more than one image, video or audio breaks when `n > 1`:

```python
GenerateReqInput(text="Compare these", image_data=["a.png", "b.png"], sampling_params={"n": 2})
# normalize_batch_and_arguments() -> ValueError: The length of image_data should be equal to the batch size.
```

The same happens on `/v1/chat/completions` with two `image_url` parts and `n=2`: a 400 error, while `n=1` works. For video and audio nothing is raised, but each sample only gets the **first** item (`obj[0].video_data == "v1"`), so the model answers about one video.

Cause: with `n > 1`, `_handle_parallel_sampling` turns a single request into a batch of one and wraps `text` / `input_ids` / `input_embeds`, but not the media fields. The batch helpers then read the request's flat media list as one entry per request. This is the same issue #7830 fixed for `input_embeds`.

## Modifications

`python/sglang/srt/managers/io_struct.py`: when the single request is converted to a batch, also wrap a non-empty flat list in `image_data`, `video_data`, `audio_data`, `mm_hashes` and `mm_content_hashes`. A list already given as one entry per request (`[["a.png", "b.png"]]`), a single non-list item and an empty list keep their current paths, so those requests and `n = 1` are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: request normalization only.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the pre-commit hooks.
- [x] Add unit tests: `test_parallel_sampling_keeps_every_media_item_of_a_single_request` in `test/registered/unit/managers/test_io_struct.py`. For images, videos and audios (and `mm_hashes` alignment), `req[0]` must carry both items. It fails on `main` (a `ValueError` for images and hashes, `'m1' != ['m1', 'm2']` for video and audio) and passes with the fix. `test_parallel_sampling_keeps_media_already_nested_per_request` checks that media and hashes already nested per request (`[["m1", "m2"]]`) are not wrapped again; it passes on `main` and with the fix.

  `pytest test/registered/unit/{managers,observability,utils,disaggregation,entrypoints/openai}` gives 2085 passed on this branch vs 2084 on `main`, with an identical set of failures on both (my CPU-only environment has no GPU or HF access).
- [ ] Update documentation (no user-facing change beyond the fix).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

Related: #41546 (open) edits the same `_handle_parallel_sampling` for input validation and LoRA metadata, but doesn't touch the media fields, so the two don't overlap in behavior; whichever lands second needs a small rebase.

cc @mickqian, who added the `mm_hashes` normalization.

Developed with AI assistance (Claude); every changed line was reviewed and the tests were run locally by me.

+        )

+        self.assertEqual(req[0].image_data, ["i1", "i2"])
